item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 1 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Rainfall Advisory No. 1 #SLPRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at 08:00 PM 17 August 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rains are expected over #OrientalMindoro(Naujan, Victoria, Pola, Socorro, Pinamalayan, Gloria, Bansud) and #Romblon within the next 2 to 3 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #OrientalMindoro(PuertoGalera, SanTeodoro, Baco, CityOfCalapan, Bongabong, Roxas, Mansalay and Bulalacao) which may persist within 2 to 3 hours.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 11:00 PM Today.

item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 6 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 6 #SLPRSD
Issued at 08:05 PM 17 August 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Masbate(PioV.Corpuz and Esperanza) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Masbate(Cawayan, Palanas, Placer and Cataingan) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.

item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Watch #SLPRSD
Issued at 10:00 AM 17 August 2026

Thunderstorm is MORE LIKELY to develop over #BicolRegion within 12 hours.

The public is advised to continue monitoring for updates.
